newsitem.title: USA: Three-Five wins contract for phone displays.
newsitem.headline: Three-Five wins contract for phone displays.

text.p: Three-Five Systems Inc on Tuesday said it has won a production order to make liquid crystal display modules for cordless telephones.
Financial details were not disclosed, but Three-Five said it "expects measurable revenue during the second quarter of this year." Production will start in the first quarter .

The order was placed by an unnamed U.S.-based manufacturer of telecommunications equipment. The displays will be installed in cordless phones that have a caller identification feature. The phones also will offer call waiting and 25 channel selections. They will be distributed in the U.S.
